subject.title: fix(agents): skip model-override repair and visibility gate for locked sessions

question: Should every modelSelectionLocked session be allowed to retain and run its owner-selected provider/model even when that model is outside agents.defaults.models?
rationale: The patch is internally consistent and fixes the demonstrated failure, but it changes the precedence between a plugin-owned durable session invariant and a user-configured model visibility policy; repository history does not make that product contract explicit enough for automation to choose safely.

options.title: Honor durable locks
options.body: Confirm that modelSelectionLocked is authoritative for owner-created sessions, refresh the branch, and merge with explicit locked-outside-allowlist regression coverage.

options.title: Require validated ownership
options.body: Narrow the bypass to sessions carrying validated harness or plugin ownership metadata so a bare persisted lock flag cannot override visibility policy.

options.title: Keep the allowlist absolute
options.body: Retain visibility enforcement and redesign adopted CLI sessions so their models are registered or explicitly allowed before execution.

recommendation.title: Honor durable locks
recommendation.body: Confirm that modelSelectionLocked is authoritative for owner-created sessions, refresh the branch, and merge with explicit locked-outside-allowlist regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is recent ownership of Claude CLI session binding and live model-routing behavior.
